title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – September 22, 2026
note:
### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – September 22, 2026

#### Bug Fix Update

This is a bug fix update. Replay codes have been wiped.

#### Bug Fixes

General

* Fixed a bug where Team Drives titles showed placeholder text.
* Fixed a bug where Drive Signature prestige levels may have changed after Team Drives.
* Fixed a bug with the scope on Ashe's Metalcore skin.
note_cn:
### 《守望先锋》补丁说明 – 2026年9月22日

#### 错误修复更新

本次更新修复了部分错误。此前的回放代码已失效。

#### 错误修复

综合

* 修复了团队竞逐（Team Drives）头衔显示占位文本的问题。
* 修复了团队竞逐结束后，竞逐签名（Drive Signature）的声望等级可能发生变化的问题。
* 修复了艾什“Metalcore”皮肤瞄准镜的问题。
